Explain briefly why condensation appears on the outside of a glass of iced water on a humid day. Aim for approximately 28–44 English tokens.

message.content: The cold glass surface cools the surrounding warm, humid air below its dew point. Consequently, water vapor in the air condenses into liquid droplets on the exterior of the glass, creating visible moisture due to the significant temperature difference.
